messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: TRNG lib
parts:
I looked at the TRNG PDF doc (it's a bit
out of date) and it shouldn't be a big deal to
swap it in for the ecuyer1988 version we're using
now.

The concepts we need to implement are on this page:

http://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_51_0/doc/html/boost_random/reference.html

Pretty much just some typedefs and

operator()()

for generating RNGs and

discard(uintmax_t)

for skipping ahead.

You can see an example here:

http://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_51_0/doc/html/boost/random/additive_combine_engine.html

We used the instantiation here:

http://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_51_0/doc/html/boost/random/ecuyer1988.html

- Bob

P.S. I see now that TRNG used to be GPL, which would've
ruled it out before. It's now BSD 3-clause, which is OK.
